title: 第14章  见南宫明月
content_zh:
“烬生哥哥，我们两个住在哪里呀？”
林月舒站在半山腰处，目光四处扫视，却看不见半间房屋，不由得疑惑道。
“我们还是先种植灵药吧，等待会张长老回来之后，应该会给我们安排住处！”
苏烬生看着不远处的那片空地，开口回答道。
反正这些杂活迟早都是他们的，早干晚干都是要干的。
不如早点做完，还能够有些空余的时间去修炼。
“嗯！”
“我先去把那些枯萎的银龙草给拔了！”
林月舒点头出声，随即便迈步走向那片枯萎的银龙草之地，开始清理了起来。
这一片空地乃是廉妄言刚刚种下的，一共种了五十株，只有三两株存活而已。
而那些枯萎的银龙草必须要拔除才行，不然只会白占地方。
苏烬生则开始移植起了银龙草，开始整齐的种植了起来。
速度越来越快，动作也越来越娴熟，不过一刻钟的时间，便已有几十株的银龙草种植下去。
且都是灵光闪闪，无半点萎靡之状。
甚至有时候苏烬生的动作粗暴几分，也不会影响这银龙草存活。
这让他更加坚信，这一切都是因为体内精纯灵气的缘故。
否则，根本不可能有如此高的存活率！
他也相信林月舒必定是不凡的，否则，也不可能种植出全部存活的灵药。
虽然当前他还无法查探出是何等原因，但日后实力强大了，一定会查探清楚！
“都说种植灵药难，存活率低！”

“我看也没有那么难嘛！”
林月舒一手抓着一株银龙草，用脚踩出两个坑，随意的将银龙草放进去。
而后又将土随意埋了回去，转头又继续移植了起来。
即便是如此粗糙的动作，这些银龙草依旧存活，没有半点枯败的迹象。
不过才刚种植了两刻钟灵药，便见两道身影从远处飞驰而来。
一步十丈，眨眼间的功夫便已至身前！
苏烬生看清楚来人容貌之后，直接愣在了原地，像，实在是太像了！
若不是事先知晓的话，恐怕他真会认为，三日前与自己温存的人就是宗主呢！
虽然他先前也见过宗主，但那都是一年之前的事情了。
今日再次相见，简直和那个双胞胎妹妹南宫问月一模一样，挑不出半点不同之处！
“灵药峰弟子，林月舒，见过宗主！”
林月舒见到宗主前来之后，便连忙将手中银龙草种植而下，走上前来，毕恭毕敬出声。
虽然她之前一直都是杂役弟子，但苏烬生先前带她见过宗主，所以识得眼前人。
南宫明月见到苏烬生之后，脑海中也不由得想起山洞中的事情。
心跳不由得加速几分，好像有种小鹿乱撞的感觉，但表面上依旧保持镇定，神色冰冷如常。
“苏烬生，还不快见过宗主！”
张长老见苏烬生直勾勾的盯着宗主，却不曾言语问好，不由得训斥出声道。
要知道，宗主可是最厌烦那些直视她的人，尤其是男人！
因为宗主长相绝美，凡是直视入迷的人，均被视为贪财好色之徒。
所以，无论是长老还是弟子，平常也只有说话的时候敢直视，其余时候均是看向别处。

“灵药峰弟子，见过宗主！”
苏烬生回神，连忙毕恭毕敬的开口问好，心中则是暗道。
真是奇怪，世间怎么会有如此相像的双胞胎呢？
“宗主，灵药峰弟子失礼，稍后我会进行责罚！”
张长老的脸上露出一抹笑容，开口道。
“无妨！”
南宫明月神色平静，言语冰冷，不带有丝毫感情，开口出声。
暗地里则是腹诽道，没想到，苏烬生竟然真的达到了练气五重境！
这不过才三天时间，他是如何做到的？
“听张长老说，你们二人种植的灵药可全部存活，所以便前来查看一番！”
张长老闻言，连忙将目光看向一旁的二人，叮嘱出声道。
“苏烬生，林月舒，你们两个现在把这里的银龙草种植一下！”
“是！”
“是！”
苏烬生和林月舒二人连忙点头出声，而后便开始种植起了银龙草。
眼前的银龙草还剩下两百来株，足以将最后一片空地种完。
并且，还能多出个几十株出来。
原本按照张长老估计，这些银龙草根本不足以种满这几块空地。
毕竟，损失率实在是太高了。
谁曾想，冒出苏烬生和林月舒这两个逆天之才，直接种活了全部的银龙草，还有多余的出来。

简直是意外之喜！
二人动作平常，没有半点特殊性，却能够成功移植活银龙草，属实是震惊了一旁观看的两人。
虽然张长老方才已经见识过一遍了，但再看一遍后，还是感到震惊，不可思议！
至于南宫明月就更别说了，双目瞪大，神识扫过一株株闪烁银光的灵药，震惊无比。
竟，竟然真的全部都移植活了！
这，这般逆天之人，竟然一直在当杂役弟子！
若是能够早几年发现，那他们紫幕神山不知将省下多少损失！
“好！”
“自今日起，你们两个便负责种植灵药，宗门一切任务都与你们无关！”
南宫明月双眸中绽放精光，心中满是激动之色，就连声音都变得有力几分。
随即，目光扫过苏烬生那道身影，声音平静了几分。
“从这个月开始，你们二人每个月可领取一万枚下品灵石，一百枚凝气丹！”
闻言，林月舒脸上满是惊喜之色，心中震惊道。
一，一万枚下品灵石，一百枚凝气丹！
这，这未免也太多了吧！
要知道，先前她为杂役弟子的时候，每个月只能领取一枚凝气丹，十枚下品灵石！
如今，凝气丹直接翻了百倍，下品灵石更是翻了一千倍！
这泼天富贵砸在身上，让她顿感一阵头晕目眩！
而苏烬生则是显得十分平静，并无表露出太过震惊，毕竟，他曾经是内门弟子第一人。
所拥有过的修炼资源比这要多的多的多！

“多谢宗主！”
道谢之后，心中暗道，真不愧是双胞胎，就连声音都是如此的相似！
“多谢宗主！”
林月舒也是反应了过来，脸上笑容遮掩不住的道谢出声。
一旁的张长老并不表情变化，心里毫无波澜。
因为这些修炼资源对比二人所产生的利益来算，简直不值一提。
“张长老，你们灵药峰的事情我不掺和，你全权安排即可！”
“希望能够看到灵药丹药的收益成倍增长！”
南宫明月不敢与苏烬生对视，便将目光落到了一旁张长老的身上，叮嘱出声道。
“宗主放心，必定让您满意！”
张长老脸上笑容浓郁，满怀信心的回答出声。
毕竟，无半点损耗移植灵药，这收益翻个几倍，就跟玩一样。
“嗯！”
南宫明月轻轻点了点头，最后瞟了一眼苏烬生之后，身影闪烁间，便离开了灵药峰。
她不敢多待，生怕苏烬生察觉出什么端倪来。
“你们两个跟我来，我来安排你们住处！”
张长老见宗主离去之后，便直接迈步朝着山上走去，同时开口出声。
音落，苏烬生和林月舒便紧跟着其步伐，朝着山上走去。
途中，林月舒轻声细语道。
“烬生哥哥，我怎么感觉宗主有些不敢与你对视呢？”

苏烬生不以为意的笑了笑，回答道。
“怎么可能，肯定是你感觉错了！”
content_en:
"Brother Jinsheng, where do we two live?"
Lin Yueshu stood halfway up the mountain, looking around, but couldn't see half of the house, and couldn't help but wonder.
"Let's plant the elixir first. When Elder Hui Zhang comes back, he should arrange a place for us!"
Su Jinsheng looked at the open space not far away and answered.
Anyway, these chores will be theirs sooner or later, and they have to do them morning and night.
It's better to finish it early and still have some free time to practice.
"Yeah!"
"I'm going to pull out those withered silver dragon grasses first!"
Lin Yueshu nodded and then walked towards the withered Silver Dragon Grass and began to clean it up.
This open space was just planted by Lian Wangyan. A total of fifty plants were planted, but only three or two survived.
And those withered silver dragon grass must be pulled out, otherwise they will only take up space in vain.
Su Jinsheng began to transplant the silver dragon grass and began to plant it neatly.
The speed became faster and faster, and the movements became more and more skillful. Within a quarter of an hour, dozens of Silver Dragon Grass plants were planted.
And they are all sparkling with energy, without the slightest sign of sluggishness.
Even Su Jinsheng's rough movements sometimes would not affect the survival of the Silver Dragon Grass.
This made him even more convinced that all this was due to the pure spiritual energy in his body.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to have such a high survival rate!
He also believed that Lin Yueshu must be extraordinary, otherwise, it would be impossible to plant all the surviving elixirs.
Although he is still unable to find out the reason, he will definitely find out when he becomes stronger in the future!
"They say it is difficult to grow elixirs and the survival rate is low!"
"I don't think it's that difficult!"
Lin Yueshu grabbed a silver dragon grass with one hand, stepped on two holes with his feet, and put the silver dragon grass in at will.
Then he buried the soil back casually, turned around and continued transplanting.
Even with such rough movements, these silver dragon grasses are still alive and show no signs of withering.
But just two-quarters of an hour after planting the elixir, two figures were seen flying from a distance.
One step is ten feet, and in the blink of an eye you are already in front of you!
After Su Jinsheng saw the person's appearance clearly, he froze on the spot. He looked so similar!
If he hadn't known it in advance, he might have thought that the person he was friendly with three days ago was the sect leader!
Although he had met the sect leader before, that was a year ago.
When we met again today, she looked exactly like her twin sister Nangong Wenyue. There was no difference at all!
"Lin Yueshu, a disciple of Spiritual Medicine Peak, has met the sect master!"
When Lin Yueshu saw the sect master coming, he quickly planted the Silver Dragon Grass in his hand, stepped forward and spoke respectfully.
Although she had always been a handyman disciple before, Su Jinsheng had brought her to meet the sect master before, so she knew the person in front of her.
After Nangong Mingyue saw Su Jinsheng, she couldn't help but think of what happened in the cave.
His heartbeat couldn't help but accelerate a bit, as if he was bumping into a deer, but he remained calm on the surface, his expression as cold as usual.
"Su Jinsheng, why don't you meet the sect leader soon!"
Elder Zhang saw Su Jinsheng staring directly at the sect leader without saying hello, so he couldn't help scolding him.
You know, the sect master hates those who look directly at her the most, especially men!
Because the sect leader is extremely beautiful, anyone who looks directly at him in ecstasy will be regarded as a greedy and lustful person.
Therefore, whether they are elders or disciples, they usually only dare to look directly when speaking, and look away the rest of the time.
"Disciples of Spiritual Medicine Peak have met the sect master!"
Su Jinsheng came back to his senses and quickly said hello respectfully, thinking secretly in his heart.
It's really strange, how can there be such similar twins in the world?
"Sect Master, the disciples of Spiritual Medicine Peak are rude and I will punish you later!"
A smile appeared on Elder Zhang's face and he openedMouth.
"It doesn't matter!"
Nangong Mingyue's expression was calm, her words were cold, and she spoke without any emotion.
Secretly, he cursed, "I didn't expect that Su Jinsheng had actually reached the fifth level of Qi training!"
It only took three days, how did he do it?
"I heard from Elder Zhang that all the elixirs planted by the two of you can survive, so I came to check it out!"
Upon hearing this, Elder Zhang quickly looked at the two people on the side and shouted.
"Su Jinsheng, Lin Yueshu, you two should plant the silver dragon grass here now!"
"Yes!"
"Yes!"
Su Jinsheng and Lin Yueshu nodded quickly, and then began to plant Silver Dragon Grass.
There are still about two hundred Silver Dragon Grass plants in front of me, enough to plant the last open space.
Moreover, dozens more plants can be produced.
Originally, according to Elder Zhang's estimation, these silver dragon grasses were not enough to plant these open spaces.
After all, the loss rate is too high.
Who would have thought that two extraordinary talents, Su Jinsheng and Lin Yueshu, would directly plant all the Silver Dragon Grass and still have some extra.
What a surprise!
The two people's movements were ordinary and nothing special, but they were able to successfully transplant the living silver dragon grass, which really shocked the two people watching.
Although Elder Zhang had already seen it once before, after watching it again, he was still shocked and unbelievable!
Not to mention Nangong Mingyue, her eyes widened as her consciousness swept over the elixirs that shone with silver light. She was extremely shocked.
Surprisingly, all of them were transplanted and survived!
This, such a defiant person has been working as a handyman disciple!
If it could have been discovered a few years earlier, they would have saved Zimu Shenshan a lot of losses!
"Okay!"
"From today on, you two will be responsible for planting elixirs. All tasks of the sect have nothing to do with you!"
Nangong Mingyue's eyes sparkled, her heart was filled with excitement, and even her voice became a little stronger.
Immediately, his eyes swept over Su Jinsheng's figure, and his voice became calmer.
"Starting from this month, you two can receive 10,000 low-grade spiritual stones and 100 Qi Condensing Pills every month!"
Hearing this, Lin Yueshu's face was full of surprise and she was shocked in her heart.
One, ten thousand low-grade spiritual stones and one hundred Qi Condensing Pills!
This, this is too much!
You know, when she was a handyman disciple, she could only receive one Qi Condensation Pill and ten low-grade spiritual stones every month!
Now, the Qi Condensing Pill has doubled directly by a hundred times, and the low-grade spirit stone has doubled by a thousand times!
This wealth and wealth hit her, making her feel dizzy!
Su Jinsheng, on the other hand, looked very calm and did not show too much shock. After all, he was once the number one disciple in the inner sect.
The cultivation resources I have ever had are much, much more than this!
"Thank you, Master!"
After thanking them, I thought to myself, they are indeed twins, even their voices are so similar!
"Thank you, Master!"
Lin Yueshu also responded, thanking her with a smile that couldn't be concealed on her face.
Elder Zhang on the side did not change his expression, and his heart was not disturbed.
Because these cultivation resources are simply not worth mentioning compared to the benefits generated by the two of them.
"Elder Zhang, I will not interfere with your affairs at Spiritual Medicine Peak. You have full authority to make arrangements!"
"I hope to see the income from the elixirs and elixirs increase exponentially!"
Nangong Mingyue did not dare to look at Su Jinsheng, so she cast her eyes on Elder Zhang beside him and gave instructions.
"Don't worry, Sect Master, I will definitely satisfy you!"
Elder Zhang had a big smile on his face and answered with confidence.
After all, by transplanting the elixir without any loss, the income will be doubled several times, just like playing.
"Yeah!"
Nangong Mingyue nodded slightly, and after taking one last look at Su Jinsheng, she left the Spiritual Medicine Peak in a flash of light.
She didn't dare to stay longer, for fear that Su Jinsheng would notice something.
"You two are following meCome, I will arrange your accommodation! "
After Elder Zhang saw the sect leader leaving, he walked directly towards the mountain and spoke at the same time.
As soon as the sound fell, Su Jinsheng and Lin Yueshu followed closely and walked towards the mountain.
On the way, Lin Yueshu whispered softly.
"Brother Jinsheng, why do I feel that the sect leader is afraid to look at you? "
Su Jinsheng smiled nonchalantly and replied.
"How is that possible? You must have felt wrong! "
